spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  metric_name,
  value,
  timestamp
FROM
  otelspam.perf
WHERE
  run_id = '${run_id}'
  AND metric_name IN ('target_bytes_per_second', 'read_uncompressed_bytes_per_second', 'read_compressed_bytes_per_second', 'insert_bytes_per_second')
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY timestamp ASC
SELECT quantile(0.5)(value) FROM otelspam.perf WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' AND metric_name = 'read_compressed_bytes_per_second' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)

SELECT
  metric_name,
  value,
  timestamp
FROM
  otelspam.perf
WHERE
  run_id = '${run_id}'
  AND metric_name IN ('user_queries_per_second')
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY timestamp ASC

SELECT
  metric_meta,
  quantile(0.5)(value),
  toStartOfSecond(timestamp) as timestamp
FROM
  otelspam.perf
WHERE
  run_id = '${run_id}'
  AND metric_name = 'query_latency_micros'
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY metric_meta, timestamp
ORDER BY timestamp ASC

SELECT
  metric_name,
  value,
  timestamp
FROM
  otelspam.perf
WHERE
  run_id = '${run_id}'
  AND metric_name IN ('read_rows_per_second', 'insert_rows_per_second')
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY timestamp ASC

SELECT
  metric_name,
  value,
  timestamp
FROM
  otelspam.perf
WHERE
  run_id = '${run_id}'
  AND metric_name IN ('active_readers', 'active_inserters', 'active_users')
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY timestamp ASC

SELECT
  metric_name,
  value,
  timestamp
FROM
  otelspam.perf
WHERE
  run_id = '${run_id}'
  AND metric_name IN ('total_rows')
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY timestamp ASC

SELECT
  metric_name,
  value,
  timestamp
FROM
  otelspam.perf
WHERE
  run_id = '${run_id}'
  AND metric_name IN ('total_bytes_uncompressed', 'total_bytes_compressed')
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY timestamp ASC
SELECT value FROM otelspam.perf WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' AND metric_name = 'target_bytes_per_second' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp) ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT quantile(0.5)(value) FROM otelspam.perf WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' AND metric_name = 'insert_rows_per_second' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
SELECT quantile(0.5)(value) FROM otelspam.perf WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' AND metric_name = 'read_uncompressed_bytes_per_second' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
SELECT any(data_type), FROM otelspam.runs WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
